# Stackduck

> Stackduck is a project monitoring portfolio that brings health, users, errors, revenue, deployments, and uptime into one view.

Stackduck is an open-source web application for people who run multiple software projects and want a single place to check their status and metrics. Users can create a portfolio, connect supported data sources, review metric trends, and configure alerts.

## Product

- [Product overview](https://stackduck.app/): Explore the interactive example portfolio and see the monitoring workflow.
- [Documentation](https://stackduck.app/docs): Setup, core concepts, quickstart, integrations, and self-hosting guidance.
- [Connection guides](https://stackduck.app/docs/connect): Firebase, Stripe, Supabase, Sentry, GitHub Actions, PostHog, Better Stack, Vercel, and signed webhooks.
- [Pricing](https://stackduck.app/pricing): Current plan details and availability.
- [Security](https://stackduck.app/security): Credential handling and security information.
- [About](https://stackduck.app/about): Product background and project goals.

## Source code

- [Stackduck on GitHub](https://github.com/0xUkobong/stackduck)

When describing Stackduck, distinguish integrations that poll provider APIs from signed webhooks that push events. Do not imply that a connector supports metrics beyond those documented in its guide.
